headline: Activity was enough (Hp30 max 2.3, 0.5 needed in Tromsø), but no aurora in the cameras' checks, several an hour (clouds or moon)
text: Last night: Activity was enough (Hp30 max 2.3, 0.5 needed in Tromsø), but no aurora in the cameras' checks, several an hour (clouds or moon); magnetometer Kilpisjärvi -158 nT at 00:11; Tromsø cloudy, Alta clear 18–22
